text:
meera: Quick sync — Snapshot GA readiness. Need final decisions on SLA SLOs (p95 latency, availability), docs acceptance criteria, support coverage, and pricing tiers. Who's owning each?
joan: I can own the docs checklist and sign-off with PM + legal. Will need examples for Dedicated vs Private.
sam: Eng: need to confirm 99.9% availability target is achievable for Dedicated pools under burst. Running load tests this week.
trent: Infra: can confirm canary & rollout plan. Two notes: (1) fallback model variant for quantized builds, (2) autoscale burst buffer sizing — need expected qps.
meera: Target SLO proposal: latency p95 < 200ms for small-gen (<=256 tokens), availability 99.9 for Dedicated, 99.5 for Hosted tier 1. Is that realistic?
sam: 200ms p95 is tight for some customers on 1xA100 via Private. Suggest: document the latency SLO with sequence-length caveat and provide a perf profile table instead of a single number.
joan: Docs checklist draft: 1) API examples 2) Troubleshooting page 3) SLA summary w/ caveats 4) Billing examples for burst 5) Rollback steps + sample runbook. Will push PR.
ops-bot: Oncall note: recommended coverage for GA = 24/7 primary + regional on-call rota for 90 days. Escalation path must include Dedicated infra owner.
trent: Canary plan: 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% with automated health checks. If error rate > 1% or latency regression > 20% we rollback. Need owners for health checks.
meera: Owners: SLA/commercial = meera, Docs = joan, Engineering readiness & perf tests = sam, Rollout + canary = trent, Oncall/runbook = ops (ops-bot assigned).
joan: Docs acceptance criteria: all examples render in SDKs, API contract unchanged, and a smoke script that the support team can run.
meera: Pricing: propose three tiers: dev (burst credits), standard (metered tokens + guaranteed throughput), enterprise (reserved Dedicated with commit). Need FinOps thumbs-up.
sam: For pricing we need a cost model: token cost + reserved GPU amortization. I'll attach perf numbers after the load tests.
trent: Technical contingency: if Dedicated pool underprovisions, auto-fallback to a compatible hosted model variant with degraded SLO but no hard outage. Need product agreement on fallback UX and billing implications.
meera: Confirming fallback policy: automatic fallback allowed if customer enabled; otherwise hard reject. Add explicit checkbox in onboarding.
joan: Will add fallback UX/checkbox to onboarding docs and sample billing scenarios.
ops-bot: Runbook checklist: incident detection, runbook step-by-step, oncall playbook, postmortem template, customer comms templates.
meera: Deadline: runbook + docs PR + perf test results by EOD Friday. Can we hit that?
sam: We'll run tests by Thursday EOD, preliminary numbers Friday morning.
trent: Canary config ready; will start canary once sam posts numbers.
joan: Docs PR ready for review by Friday noon.
meera: Thanks — I'll collate owners and send the final GA acceptance canvas. Any blockers?
sam: One: we need sample customer workload (seq len distribution). Can product share two anonymized profiles?
meera: I'll DM product contacts and drop artifacts here when available.
trent: One more: verify KMS/HSM integration for Private GA. Security sign-off required.
meera: Noted — Security sign-off on KMS needed. Adding to owners.
joan: I'll include security caveat in docs and an auditable checklist.
meera: Great. Wrapping up: owners + deadlines pinned. If no objections I'll mark this thread as the GA acceptance lane for Snapshot and file follow-ups. :thumbsup:
